ms.report:
We have completed the following tasks, activities, and work:
Conducted a thorough review of the security audit paper to ensure a clear understanding of the
issues and recommendations.
Implemented all of the recommended fixes and updates to the dApp Wallet Connector code,
including bug fixes, code optimizations, and security enhancements.
Conducted additional testing and debugging to ensure the stability and reliability of the dApp
Wallet Connector following the updates.
Collaborated with the auditors to address any questions or concerns they had about the
implemented fixes.
Conducted a final review of the code to ensure that all of the recommendations in the audit
paper were addressed.
As could be seen on https://github.com/projectNEWM/contracts/pull/26
